messages:
Aisha (PR): Quick update — the analyst briefing originally set for Wed 10am PT needs to move to Wed 1pm PT due to an embargo timing conflict with a partner release. Can everyone confirm availability? Also legal needs to sign off on the quote we plan to provide to Forrester. Deck here: https://drive.redwood/briefings/rl-inference-deck-v3 (will update slides after approvals).

Tom G: I can move invites. Who exactly from Forrester is attending? I want to make sure we keep timezones clear for EMEA.

Marta O: Heads up from legal: they flagged the phrase "industry-leading" in the draft quote — want either evidence or to remove.

Evan S: Forrester contact is John D. He asked for a short slide on benchmarking methodology. Can we add one?

Aisha (PR): Draft quote I'm planning to read aloud/offer for attribution:
```
"Redwood Inference's serving runtime reduces inference latency by up to 30% versus baseline open models, enabling faster user experiences at lower cost."
```
Legal please chime in on wording. If needed we can attach a short methodology note.

Jorge (Legal): Remove "industry-leading" as Marta said. Also "up to 30%" is ok if it's clearly tied to benchmarking conditions. Suggest: add parenthetical: (based on internal benchmarking vs. open baseline models using 16GB A100, 2048 context, average across three runs).

Tom G: Got it — I'll update slides 2 and 6 with the methodology blurb and add a note to the deck speaker notes. Also will send new invites for Wed 1pm PT / Thu 9pm UTC.

Marta O: Approved with Jorge's parenthetical. PR, please attach the methodology snippet to the quote when you send to analysts. Also confirm embargo time: press-bot, do we have the embargo window locked?

press-bot: Embargo registered: embargo lifts Thu 17:00 UTC. Please do not share public materials before that time.

Aisha (PR): Thanks all — I'll update the deck link, attach the methodology note, send revised quote to Forrester with the approved parenthetical, and update calendar invites. If anyone can't make 1pm PT, ping me and we'll offer a separate slot. :thumbsup:
